purpose: Prove the priority engine (Land -> Survive -> Purchase -> Travel -> Sell) end-to-end on a disposable save only. This is the specific workflow contract the generic E2E runner defers to; generic harness flags cannot authorize disposable-save mutation.
allowedScope: read the disposable-save policy and active pin
validate the pinned save name against disposable-save name patterns
launch Continue onto the pinned disposable save
drive the priority engine loop against the disposable save
mutate the pinned disposable save only
write gitignored reports and the result artifact
forbiddenScope: mutate any save that is not the approved disposable pin
treat calendar year alone as disposable authority
claim live-runtime proof when the priority engine did not run
run when Bannerlord is already active without ForgeStop first
